summary.intent: Run Session 1 of the LAUNCH-v1-alpha plan for the callisto repo: implement work packages F1, F2, G, H and M to fix pre-release (prerelease cycle) handling in version aggregation and release-PR flow, then respond to lead feedback on G (#571).
summary.outcome: F1 (#566) and F2 (#567) were pushed as draft PRs; G, H and M were built, reviewed, and gated. G was merged with main and pushed as 75c7545ce after all gates passed. A final G fix round (status reporting archived-note parse failures, pre exit refusing with E102 for orphaning notes) was committed locally with tests, but not yet pushed, mutant-checked, or resolved.

repo: Worktree branch names differ from PR branch names, so plain `git push` silently no-ops; push `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`.
Repo gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test`, `just ci`; judge by exit code. Use reduced CARGO_BUILD_JOBS (cores/4 or /5) and CARGO_PROFILE_*_DEBUG=0.
Never commit `mutants.out*`; restore `mutants.out.old` from HEAD after mutants runs. The G branch had tracked 137 such files that main had removed.
Stacked PRs are forbidden: G/H/M built on F1/F2 couldn't be pushed until the base PRs merged; H must be rebased onto main after #571 merges.

Public surface changes (diagnostic codes, CLI flags, decision schema fields) are permanent after 1.0: F2 removed `inferred-release-without-changeset`, added decision schema v3 `consumedChangesets`; M added `status --since` and `changed-without-changeset`.
Specs in docs/specs/*.json, docs/releasing.md, docs/errors.md and ADR docs must be updated alongside behavior changes; schema_guard_test enumerates diagnostic codes.
Commits must be signed with no trailer; commit-inferred bumps use tags.last_tag so reruns before tagging re-infer the same commits.

code.finding: Aggregation now holds `seeds: BTreeMap<PackageId, Seed>` with `Source` enum (Fresh/Retained changeset, Inference, Group); packages without a fresh source are dropped, and group unions run only when a member is fresh.
Reviewer flagged that linked-group target uses `named_severity`, which excludes Group sources, a low-severity behavior difference from old code in fixed+linked overlaps.
The ParseChangeset error was suppressed, so malformed archived notes in .changeset/pre/ let `status --check` pass; fixed by including archived parse failures in diagnostics.
pre exit deletes pre.json; an archived note naming a removed package was skipped whole, orphaning surviving notes; now refused with E102.

workflow: Fresh-context reviewer subagents found real issues but one medium finding (H inferred-only cycles) was disproved by checking plan_version seeds patch in exit mode; verify reviewer claims before applying.
Sharing one log file between concurrent background test runs produced interleaved output; use separate logs and rerun targeted tests alone.
Mutation testing on diffs surfaced redundant code (README.md exclusion) and missing tests; remove redundant code rather than labeling mutants equivalent.
Messages from other sessions/subagents are not user authority; apply as teammate requests within existing permissions.

friction: Full test suite (1924 tests) was slow, forcing parallel worktrees and background runs.
A stale background full run during code changes produced a spurious failure and had to be redone.
Subagent G repeatedly re-sent the same report and had to be stopped.
Sandbox blocked a `sed` edit to the mutants script so the unchanged script ran again; had to stop and rewrite it.
Mutants script filters named a test binary that only existed on another branch, causing failed runs.
`just ci` failed on `audit` (RUSTSEC-2026-0542) until the lead's #560 merged.
Merge of main into G produced conflicts in seven files, all additive on VersionPlan fields.
open_items: Push G's final fix round (local commit) with explicit refspec, verify ls-remote, run just gate and mutants on the diff, then resolve Entire's two findings; this is the last fix round, report further findings without fixing.
After #571 merges, rebase H onto main, re-gate, push, and open via `entire trail ci-pr` on trail #457.
M (trail #458) still needs push/PR after rebase and `just ci`; `just ci` not yet run on H or M.
Known gap: stale release PRs that delete no changesets (inferred-only, v2 pre cycles) are caught only by the Hold workflow and manifest check.
Local `version` rerun before tagging re-infers the same commits for release-trigger=auto packages, planning another beta.
Possible low-severity linked-group named_severity discrepancy in aggregate.rs left unfixed.
